setup: s.level = Math.max(3, s.level); fill(2); return s.triggerChaos('karen');
after: const PL = s.venue.pool; const v = s.visitors.find(v => v.kind==='karen'); const X = -PL.halfX - 1.9; v.x = X; v.z = 1.0; v.angle = Math.PI / 2; for (const p of s.people) if (Math.hypot(p.x - v.x, p.z - v.z) < 7) p.karenAnnoyed = 3; const c = s.coach; c.x = X + 1.3; c.z = 1.0; c.vx = 0; c.vz = 0; c.angle = -Math.PI / 2; return { focus: [X, 0, 1.0] };
